BE.question: When does payroll harmonisation go live in Belgium?
BE.answer: Sources disagree. 1 April 2027 according to [1] [2]; 1 January 2027 according to [2]. 1 April 2027 has the most support, but check with Jane De Smet (Transformation Office) before answering.

stamps.note: Workstream plan reviewed with the client.

passport.title: Global Payroll Harmonisation
passport.description: Harmonise payroll processes and configurations across key countries to improve efficiency, compliance and data quality.

stamps.note: Initial scope and plan reviewed.
Extended scope (17 countries) reviewed.
Conflicting go-live date: the project plan (v1.4) says 1 January 2027, the Teams thread of 18 Sep 2026 says 1 April 2027.
HR module impact is not covered by any source.

updates.summary: Project started: 12 countries in scope, go-live 1 January 2027.
Scope extended from 12 to 17 countries (added AT, PL, CZ, SK, HU).
Project plan updated to v1.4 and change log added. Go-live date unchanged (1 January 2027).

results.excerpt: Go-live for all countries in scope: 1 January 2027.

passport.title: Payroll Harmonisation Pilot 2024
passport.description: Pilot in Belgium and the Netherlands that tested a common payroll process before the global programme.

stamps.note: Pilot results reviewed.
Pilot finished and replaced by the global programme. Passport moved to the archive.

updates.summary: Final pilot report: go-live for BE and NL planned for 1 January 2026 (later replaced by the global programme).

archived.excerpt: The pilot in Belgium and the Netherlands planned go-live for 1 January 2026.
